_comment: Three 4x4 tasks (standard, Latin, diagonal; data/grid_tasks4.npz), recurrent linear attention. Condition 0: no task information. hidden 32, 2 heads (16 per head = number of cells), FFN inner 64, 4 blocks x 2 segments, no augmentation (diagonal constraints break under row/column swaps). HALF (2026-10-18): hidden 16 (2 heads of 8), FFN inner 32. FILM: task information only through a per-task scaling of the FFN gate slots, g <- g * (1 + gamma_task), gamma init 0 (no input task embedding).
